Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 16  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Southwest City, Missouri, is located in Newton County based on the sources provided by WebSurfer. The source from the Southwest City official website was misinterpreted; it stated that Southwest City is located in the "very southwest portion of Newton County," but this information is incorrect. In reality, Southwest City is located in McDonald County. The Planner failed to cross-check this information against other reliable sources, leading to the wrong conclusion that Tim DuBois was born in Newton County instead of McDonald County.
